scope.rule: Every glossary inventory item has exactly one primary browse home. Secondary discovery is via facets, aliases, context links and search; never duplicate canonical objects to make them appear in several categories.

navigation_policy.contextual_rule: Mass, Formation, PRAY, Calendar, Directory and Latin surfaces may project relevant canonical glossary objects without changing their primary category.
navigation_policy.language_behavior: Search all EN/FR/LA labels and aliases regardless of current UI language.

integrity_rules: Exactly 450 numbered inventory items are assigned.
Every numbered inventory item has exactly one primary category and one browse section.
Canonical entries may have many facets and contextual projections but only one canonical id.
Homonyms are separate canonical senses; aliases never merge different senses.
LATIN_LEXEME and LATIN_PHRASE objects link to concepts rather than duplicating concept definitions.
Directory classifications never infer canonical status from venue, community name, una-cum usage or liturgical usage alone.
Historical and PROFILE_1962 terminology must not be presented as current universal discipline.
